item.title: Forges
item.description: Termorq connects to the code forges you already use: GitHub (github.com or GitHub Enterprise Server), GitLab (gitlab.com or self-managed) and Azure DevOps. It shows the work assigned to you, the pull requests waiting for your review and your pipelines, and tells you when one of them needs you. It all runs in the desktop app with your own token. There are no webhooks and no Termorq server.
